name: TX-RTT cd4  less than 200
description: Patients on ART with CD4 &amp;lt; 200 who were lost to follow-up  (&amp;gt;28 days) in the previous quarter but returned to care within 28 days of the reporting period. Excludes deceased  and transferred-out patients.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
configJson:
{
  "version": 1,
  "patientIdColumn": "client_id",
  "populationQuery": {
    "extractFrom": "sqlTemplate"
  },
  "supportsRedisaggregation": true,
  "redisaggregationStrategy": "population-extraction",
  "themeIndependent": true,
  "dataSources": [
    "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card",
    "mamba_fact_transfer_out",
    "mamba_fact_transfer_in",
    "person"
  ],
  "sqlTemplate": "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.client_id) AS value
FROM (
         SELECT
             client_id,
             TIMESTAMPDIFF(
                     DAY,
                     MAX(return_visit_date),
                     :endDate
             ) AS ltfp_days
         FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card
         WHERE encounter_date <= :endDate
           AND return_visit_date >= :startDate
         GROUP BY client_id
     ) a

         LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT *
    FROM person p
    WHERE p.dead = 1
      AND p.death_date <= :endDate
) p
                   ON a.client_id = p.person_id

         LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT mf_to.client_id
    FROM mamba_fact_transfer_out mf_to
             LEFT JOIN mamba_fact_transfer_in mf_ti
                       ON mf_to.client_id = mf_ti.client_id
    WHERE mf_to.transfer_out_date <= :endDate
      AND (
        mf_to.transfer_out_date > mf_ti.transfer_in_date
            OR mf_ti.client_id IS NULL
        )
) mfto
                   ON a.client_id = mfto.client_id

         INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT previous.client_id
    FROM (
             SELECT
                 client_id,
                 TIMESTAMPDIFF(
                         DAY,
                         MAX(return_visit_date),
                         DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
                 ) AS ltfp_days
             FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card
             WHERE encounter_date <= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
               AND return_visit_date <= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
             GROUP BY client_id
         ) previous
    WHERE previous.ltfp_days > 28
) lost_in_previous_quarter
                    ON a.client_id = lost_in_previous_quarter.client_id

         INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT client_id
    FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card
    WHERE cd4 < 200
      AND encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
) cd4
                    ON a.client_id = cd4.client_id

WHERE a.ltfp_days <= 28
  AND p.person_id IS NULL
  AND mfto.client_id IS NULL;",

sqlTemplate:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.client_id) AS value
FROM (
         SELECT
             client_id,
             TIMESTAMPDIFF(
                     DAY,
                     MAX(return_visit_date),
                     :endDate
             ) AS ltfp_days
         FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card
         WHERE encounter_date <= :endDate
           AND return_visit_date >= :startDate
         GROUP BY client_id
     ) a

         LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT *
    FROM person p
    WHERE p.dead = 1
      AND p.death_date <= :endDate
) p
                   ON a.client_id = p.person_id

         LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT mf_to.client_id
    FROM mamba_fact_transfer_out mf_to
             LEFT JOIN mamba_fact_transfer_in mf_ti
                       ON mf_to.client_id = mf_ti.client_id
    WHERE mf_to.transfer_out_date <= :endDate
      AND (
        mf_to.transfer_out_date > mf_ti.transfer_in_date
            OR mf_ti.client_id IS NULL
        )
) mfto
                   ON a.client_id = mfto.client_id

         INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT previous.client_id
    FROM (
             SELECT
                 client_id,
                 TIMESTAMPDIFF(
                         DAY,
                         MAX(return_visit_date),
                         DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
                 ) AS ltfp_days
             FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card
             WHERE encounter_date <= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
               AND return_visit_date <= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
             GROUP BY client_id
         ) previous
    WHERE previous.ltfp_days > 28
) lost_in_previous_quarter
                    ON a.client_id = lost_in_previous_quarter.client_id

         INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT client_id
    FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card
    WHERE cd4 < 200
      AND encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
) cd4
                    ON a.client_id = cd4.client_id

WHERE a.ltfp_days <= 28
  AND p.person_id IS NULL
  AND mfto.client_id IS NULL;
